notes.title: Devlog #3 - Beyond The Labyrinths
notes.notes: [p]This is the third (and last) entry in a short series where I discuss things that have been worked on. In this devlog, I branch away from talking about things specific to regions to talk about other systems that have been improved or added. A short list of things discussed in the video:[/p][list][*][p]New NPC[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements/Fixes to the generation system[/p][/*][*][p]Two new regions: Buried Desert and Green Valleys[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of Life improvements[/p][/*][*][p]General optimizations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="B3cbU8KJPDg;full"][/previewyoutube]
